stories.headline: OpenAI Agrees to Pay Cerebras $20B+ for Chips, May Get Equity Ahead of Cerebras' $35B IPO

key_facts.fact: OpenAI struck a deal to pay Cerebras more than $20 billion over three years for use of its server chips, double the amount previously associated with the deal.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI recently struck an unusual deal to lessen its dependence on Nvidia's AI chips and potentially lower its computing expenses in the coming years.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's spending on Cerebras could reach $30 billion, which could give OpenAI an equity stake in Cerebras as part of the agreement.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's spending could reach $30B, which could give OpenAI equity rights.

key_facts.fact: Cerebras is preparing to make its IPO public as soon as Friday, aiming to raise $3 billion or more at a valuation of $35 billion or higher, a 60% premium to its $22 billion February valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Cerebras prepares public listing, eyes $35 billion-plus valuation

key_facts.fact: The deal positions Cerebras as a significant alternative to Nvidia for AI chip supply, with OpenAI seeking to reduce its dependence on a single supplier.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI recently struck an unusual deal to lessen its dependence on Nvidia's AI chips

stories.headline: Musk's TeraFab Team Contacts Applied Materials, Tokyo Electron, Lam Research for Chipmaking Gear

key_facts.fact: Staff working for the Tesla-SpaceX joint venture have sought price quotes and delivery times for chipmaking gear from Applied Materials, Tokyo Electron, and Lam Research, among others.
key_facts.excerpt: Staff working for the joint venture between Tesla Inc and SpaceX have sought price quotes and delivery times for an array of chipmaking gear

key_facts.fact: The TeraFab team contacted makers of photomasks, substrates, etchers, depositors, cleaning devices, testers, and other tools. Musk wants to move at 'light speed.'
key_facts.excerpt: they've contacted makers of photomasks, substrates, etchers, depositors, cleaning devices, testers and other tools... Musk wants to move at 'light speed'

key_facts.fact: Samsung proposed allocating more capacity for Tesla at its planned factory in Taylor, Texas, rather than supporting the TeraFab project directly.
key_facts.excerpt: The Terafab team also asked chip manufacturing partner Samsung Electronics Co for support. The South Korean company instead proposed allocating more capacity for Tesla at its planned factory in Taylor, Texas

key_facts.fact: The goal is to begin silicon manufacturing by 2029 and then scale up. Analysts estimate the project would require $5 trillion to $13 trillion in capital spending.
key_facts.excerpt: The goal is to begin silicon manufacturing by 2029 and then scale up... The project would require something like US$5 trillion to US$13 trillion in capital spending, according to estimates from Bernstein analysts

key_facts.fact: Intel has said it will join the TeraFab initiative, with CEO Lip Bu Tan posting a photo of Musk on a recent visit to the chipmaker's Santa Clara office.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel Corp said it will join the Terafab initiative, with its chief executive officer Lip Bu Tan posting a photo of Musk on a recent visit to the chipmaker's Santa Clara office

key_facts.fact: Shares of Tokyo Electron closed up 5.3% in Tokyo on the news, while Applied Materials and Lam Research rose more than 2% in pre-market trading.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Tokyo Electron closed up 5.3% in Tokyo on Thursday, while news of the talks also lifted the stock prices of chip gear makers

stories.headline: ASML Raises 2026 Revenue Guidance to €36-40B as AI Chip Demand Overwhelms Supply

key_facts.fact: ASML raised its 2026 sales forecast to between €36 billion and €40 billion, up from the previous guidance of €34-39 billion, a 4% increase.
key_facts.excerpt: ASML has raised its 2026 sales forecast to between $36 billion and $40 billion, a notable increase from previous estimates... the sales forecast for 2026 being raised by 4%

key_facts.fact: Q1 2026 net revenue was €8.8 billion, above the market consensus of €8.5 billion. Net income was €2.8 billion, above the expected €2.5 billion.

stories.headline: US Lawmakers Scale Back MATCH Act Chip Bill but Keep ASML DUV Sales Ban to China

key_facts.fact: The revised MATCH Act has been softened from its early April version but still introduces a nationwide restriction on ASML's deep ultraviolet (DUV) immersion lithography sales to China.
key_facts.excerpt: sources say the revised version has been softened but still introduces a nationwide restriction on ASML's deep ultraviolet (DUV) immersion lithography systems

key_facts.fact: The House Foreign Affairs Committee is set to vote on the bill next Wednesday, alongside more than a dozen others related to AI, semiconductors, and export controls.
key_facts.excerpt: The House Foreign Affairs Committee is set to vote on the bill next Wednesday, alongside more than a dozen others related to AI, semiconductors, and export controls.

key_facts.fact: Nationwide curbs on cryogenic etch tools (produced by Lam Research and Tokyo Electron) have been removed from the revised version.
key_facts.excerpt: many of the restrictions included in the bill's early April version have been removed, including nationwide curbs on cryogenic etch tools used in chipmaking, which are produced by Lam Research and Japan's Tokyo Electron

key_facts.fact: The bill still prohibits foreign firms from selling to China's leading memory makers and SMIC for facilities Washington has barred from using US tools, and requires licenses to service equipment in covered facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: the more targeted bill still prohibits foreign firms from selling to China's leading memory makers and SMIC for facilities that Washington has barred from using U.S. tools... the revised bill also requires licenses to service equipment in covered facilities

key_facts.fact: The earlier version was described by one expert as a 'runaway train.' Dutch PM Jetten discussed the issue with Trump at a White House dinner; the Netherlands has pushed back against proposed US export limits on ASML.
key_facts.excerpt: the early April version of the bill unsettled the industry both in the U.S. and abroad, with one expert describing it as a 'runaway train'... Dutch King Willem-Alexander, Queen Máxima, and Prime Minister Jetten attended a White House dinner hosted by President Donald Trump

stories.headline: Physical Intelligence's π0.7 Robot Model Shows Emergent Compositional Generalization

key_facts.fact: Physical Intelligence released π0.7, a steerable generalist robot foundation model that exhibits the first signs of compositional generalization — recombining skills from training data to perform tasks it was never explicitly taught.
key_facts.excerpt: π0.7 exhibiting the first signs of compositional generalization, recombining skills from various tasks to solve new problems, like using new kitchen appliances and even enabling a new robot to fold laundry for which there is no laundry folding data

key_facts.fact: π0.7 can perform dexterous tasks like operating an espresso machine or folding laundry out of the box without any task-specific fine-tuning, matching the performance of specialized RL-finetuned models.
key_facts.excerpt: it can perform a wide range of dexterous tasks with the same performance as fine-tuned specialists... perform challenging tasks such as operating an espresso machine out of the box at a level of performance that matches much more specialized RL-finetuned models

key_facts.fact: The model provides zero-shot cross-embodiment generalization, enabling a robot to fold shirts for which it had no shirt-folding training data, by transferring skills across different robot platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: provide zero-shot cross-embodiment generalization, for example enabling a robot to fold laundry without seeing the task before

key_facts.fact: In one experiment with an air fryer, success rate went from 5% to 95% after researchers spent about 30 minutes improving step-by-step language instructions, demonstrating the model's 'steerability.'
key_facts.excerpt: the success rate in the initial air fryer experiment stayed at about 5 percent, but rose to 95 percent after improving the way the task was explained for about 30 minutes

key_facts.fact: Co-founder Sergey Levine said the compositional generalization is 'similar to scaling characteristics seen in language and vision models,' comparing the breakthrough to emergent capabilities in early LLMs.
key_facts.excerpt: If you move beyond a stage where you perform only precisely trained tasks and move to a stage where you combine them in new ways, the magnitude of performance improvement grows... This is similar to scaling characteristics seen in language and vision models.

sources.title: π0.7: a Steerable Model with Emergent Capabilities

stories.headline: Google-Backed Venture Sells Record $5.7B Junk Bond to Build Two Indiana AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Data centers linked to Alphabet's Google are seeking to raise $5.7 billion from a junk-bond sale, the largest US dollar junk bond ever to finance the AI buildout boom.
key_facts.excerpt: Data centres linked to Alphabet's Google are seeking to raise US$5.7 billion from a junk-bond sale, in what would be the largest deal of its kind to finance the artificial intelligence buildout boom.

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley kicked off marketing on Wednesday (April 15) and is expected to price the notes as soon as this week. The proceeds will fund two data centers on a campus in Sullivan County, Indiana.
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley kicked off its marketing on Wednesday (Apr 15), and is expected to price the notes as soon as this week... The proceeds will fund the construction of two data centres on a campus in Sullivan County, Indiana

key_facts.fact: The data centers will be leased to cloud-compute startup FluidStack and backstopped by Google. The JV issuing the bonds is called Meridian Arc HoldCo, owned by Next Frontier and FluidStack.
key_facts.excerpt: which will be leased to cloud-computer startup Fluidstack and backstopped by Google... A joint venture (JV) owned by Next Frontier and Fluidstack is selling the new five-year notes. The bonds will be issued by Meridian Arc HoldCo

key_facts.fact: FluidStack recently announced a $50 billion deal with Anthropic to build custom data centers and is in talks to raise $1 billion at an $18 billion valuation led by Jane Street and Situational Awareness.
key_facts.excerpt: The firm recently announced a US$50 billion deal with Anthropic to build custom data centres for the large language model maker.

stories.headline: NiSource Signs Long-Term Power Deal With Alphabet, Expands Amazon Agreement for Indiana Data Centers

key_facts.fact: US utility NiSource signed a long-term energy supply agreement with a unit of Alphabet to support a large data center in northern Indiana, with power supply expected to begin in summer 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. utility NiSource said on Thursday it had signed a long-term energy supply agreement with a unit of Alphabet to support a large data center in northern Indiana.

key_facts.fact: NiSource also expanded its agreement with Amazon to speed up power delivery to its facilities and accelerate bill credits for households.
key_facts.excerpt: The company also said it had expanded an agreement with Amazon to speed up power delivery to its sites and bring forward bill credits for households.

key_facts.fact: NIPSCO and GenCo will provide about 340 megawatts of dedicated capacity from a GenCo-owned portfolio supplemented by up to 175 megawatts of seasonal market purchases.
key_facts.excerpt: NIPSCO and GenCo will provide generation and transmission infrastructure to serve data centers, with about 340 megawatts from a GenCo-owned portfolio supplemented by up to 175 megawatts of seasonal market purchases.

key_facts.fact: NiSource estimates about $1.25 billion in system-wide customer savings — roughly $90 to $115 annually per household — through its GenCo model that shields existing customers from added costs.
key_facts.excerpt: The company estimates about $1.25 billion in system-wide savings, translating to roughly $90 to $115 annually per household.

key_facts.fact: CEO Lloyd Yates said the savings expand on the previously announced $1 billion in customer savings from the Amazon deal.
key_facts.excerpt: The cost savings announced today expand on the previously announced $1 billion in customer savings with Amazon as we continue to work closely with a broad coalition of stakeholders to bring this GenCo vision to life
